note: File contents and copied filesystem dates are not included. Descriptions come from comments, declarations, and file headers in this archive. Uncertain entries are marked.

folderDescriptions.description: Top of the leaked Chicken Run source copy. The two named folders are the Dreamcast game tree and a small PSI model viewer adapted from the Frogger 2 shell.
folderDescriptions.basis: Identified from the contained folder names, makefiles, and source trees

folderDescriptions.description: Primary Dreamcast working tree. Its root contains the Katana port, while its subfolders preserve the PlayStation build, a source snapshot, copied headers, lookup tables, and Visual Studio metadata.
folderDescriptions.basis: Identified from the contained makefiles, projects, and source trees

folderDescriptions.description: Parallel source snapshot kept beside the Dreamcast files. Many files match the root tree, while others preserve alternate revisions of the same shared game code.
folderDescriptions.basis: Identified by comparing shared filenames and file contents

folderDescriptions.description: Visual Studio 6 and SourceSafe metadata for the Win32 external-target project. This folder records the PC project and its original source-control connection rather than another copy of the game code.
folderDescriptions.basis: Identified from the DSP, build log, and source-control metadata

folderDescriptions.description: Binary maths lookup tables used by the shared engine: arccosine data and a square-root table. The assembly include file that embeds these tables sits in the parent source tree.
folderDescriptions.basis: Identified from the binary filenames and declarations in incbin.s

folderDescriptions.description: Local include directory containing copied Sony PlayStation SDK headers and headers for the in-house ISL libraries used by the shared and Dreamcast-conversion code.
folderDescriptions.basis: Identified from header names and declarations

folderDescriptions.description: PlayStation PSYQ build tree. It contains the PlayStation-oriented copy of the game code, regional and demo makefiles, linker scripts, mastering batches, and platform-specific support files.
folderDescriptions.basis: Identified from the PSYQ makefiles, linker scripts, and mastering commands

folderDescriptions.description: Small Katana and Kamui 2 model viewer built around the PSI model plotter. Its startup code still identifies it as the Frogger 2 shell, showing the tool was adapted for Chicken Run artists.
folderDescriptions.basis: Identified from the makefile, entry point, and model-rendering sources
